verdict: key consistent once the plaintext is corrected: 82 signs = 82 letters, 20 groups = 20 words; one shape (S10) takes ي six times and ص twice, and ف/ق share two shapes (S15, S16); the rest one letter per shape
notes: Rows: folio lines 12r l.8-14 = segmenter lines 6-12 of image 0084_0028 (row labels here are folio lines). 14+11+11+14+10+11+11 = 82 signs (record 98), 20 dividers (record 24); row 12r.12 opens and row 12r.14 ends with a divider. The record's 'partial' fit (98 vs 70) comes from a sign over-count and two words left out: the cipher ends verse 1 with 'القايل' (6 signs, between 'فينا' and 'لما') and verse 2 with 'دلايل' (5 signs, after 'عليك'); these are the interlinear words on 12v (above l.3: read 'القابر' by the record, and below l.3 at the left), which complete the two lines. Other record errors: 'لا ابتخت' -> 'لا لاني بحت' (groups S5 S4 | S5 S4 S9 S10 | S11 S6 S12 = لا | لاني | بحت; 12v l.2 can be read 'لا لانى بحت'); 'نجبت' -> 'نجب' (3 signs, S11 S6 S11; S11 is ب five times and S6 ح three times elsewhere, so the signs would also read 'بحب' with no mixed shape; the 12v copy is dotted نجب, kept here). Reading as enciphered: 'لكمال حسنك لا لاني بحت بالسر المصون اصاب فينا القايل / لما هتفت نجب من قاف الورى بجماله وضحت عليك دلايل'. S10 is ي in لاني, فينا, القايل, الورى, عليك, دلايل but ص in المصون and اصاب: no visible difference at 3-4x (P_sheet.png), so either the cipher uses one sign for both or two look-alikes were not separated. S15 is ف in هتفت, فينا and ق in قاف; S16 is ق in القايل and ف in قاف (ف/ق skeleton). ن has three shapes (S8 cup-topped in حسنك, S9 open hook, S11 in نجب, which also gives ب), ت two (S12, S21), ه one (S17), ا one (S4). S1 (C) may be a rounder S5 (both ل). All signs keyed; none left over.
